purpose: Measure the end-to-end wall-clock cost of restoring a T3-valid neural light-transport representation after the accepted worklog-21/22 teaset T0 -> T3 change, using the existing RNA and 8DNA refit paths exactly as worklog 22 ran them. Measurement of the strongest existing alternative (neural full recomputation / refit), not a method. Written before any timing run of this batch.
written_before: any smoke or evidence run of this batch; the only numbers seen beforehand are the historical ones in worklogs 21-26 and their logs (8DNA T3 refit 2 h 04 min wall in the worklog-22 chain log; RNA T3 datasets 2 h 21 min + 28 min; RNA T3 training 34 min on LabServer63, 25 min for the worklog-23 run on the 5080)

8dna.initialization: from scratch (from_scratch: true); upstream train.py with pl.seed_everything(9); no T0 weights or other learned state reused
8dna.training_data: online: PathSamplingDataset regenerates path samples from the T3 Mitsuba scene at the start of every epoch (dataset_reload 1); no stored dataset exists
8dna.schedule: upstream configs/default.yaml unchanged, 30 epochs, batch 32768, 8192 steps/epoch, Adam lr 5e-4, clip 5
8dna.checkpoint_used: last.ckpt at the end of the schedule (no selection on validation loss)
8dna.lighting: 8DNA training is lighting-independent (BSDF-sampled paths, no emitter); the one T3_refit checkpoint was evaluated in both the worklog-21 envmap regime and the common-light regime
8dna.stages_skipped_historically_because_an_a: none for the T3 refit itself (scene built from the locked translations in-process); the T0_retrain pipeline control and the references existed before
8dna.stages_required_for_a_new_configuration: scene preparation, online path generation every epoch, optimisation, per-epoch validation and checkpointing, conversion of last.ckpt to the load_asset-readable layout

rna.initialization: from scratch: official scripts/train.py with seed 0 and no init_from (the RNA code has 'TODO: Add init_from checkpoint support')
rna.training_data: offline: T3 training (200 views) and validation (40 views) H5 targets rendered by rna_bridge.py h5 on the 5080 at 512 spp, before training
rna.schedule: Rain HQ config, 250 epochs, lr 1e-3 halved every 50, log-L2, visibility weight 10
rna.checkpoint_used: validation-best val_psnr checkpoint of the official ModelCheckpoint (known only once the schedule ends)
rna.host_historical: datasets on the RTX 5080; training on LabServer63 (RTX 3080 Ti)
rna.stages_skipped_historically_because_an_a: none for the T3 refit; inference feature buffers (rna_teaset/features/T3.npz) existed from the frozen track and are inference-time inputs, not part of the representation
rna.stages_required_for_a_new_configuration: T3 target rendering (train + val), H5 writing, H5 load, optimisation, per-epoch validation and checkpointing, validation-best selection

historical_refit_semantics.warm_start: Neither method has an existing, supported warm-start path: RNA's train.py has no init_from, and 8DNA's --resume restores the trainer state of the same run (epoch counter included), which is not a fine-tune from the T0 asset. Both historical refits are scratch rebuilds. No secondary warm-start control is measured, because creating one would be new methodology (batch section 3).

definitions.REPRESENTATION_REBUILD: the method's normal untrained initialisation, built for T3 by its standard pipeline -- the primary measurement for both backbones, because it is the historical worklog-22 path
definitions.t0: the chain driver's launch of a track's first stage process, i.e. the moment the locked T3 translations are handed to the pipeline. Everything after it is counted: interpreter start-up, imports, runtime init, scene preparation, data/path generation, optimisation, validation, checkpointing, export, and the gaps between stages.
definitions.usable: 8DNA: the checkpoint written for an epoch, converted to the load_asset-readable layout (the one-off export cost is added). RNA: the Lightning checkpoint written for an epoch (read directly by rna_infer.py).
definitions.time_to_first_recovery: elapsed time from t0 until the first checkpoint that satisfies the historical recovery rule becomes usable. Oracle quantity: deciding that a checkpoint has recovered needs the path-traced T3 reference, which a deployed system does not have; it is a lower bound on practical latency.
definitions.time_to_historical_selection: elapsed time until the checkpoint the historical protocol would select is usable (8DNA: last.ckpt at the end of the schedule; RNA: validation-best, known only once all 250 epochs ran)
definitions.total_fixed_schedule_time: t0 until the track's last timed stage exits (the full historical schedule; no early stopping, none existed historically)
definitions.instrumentation_overhead: snapshot_write (per-epoch weight copies for offline evaluation) and torch.cuda.synchronize at phase boundaries; snapshot_write is reported and subtracted in the 'excluding instrumentation' figures

8dna_envmap_primary.role: PRIMARY timing anchor and successful-recovery case (worklog-22 envmap refit: ratio 1.07, gain 0.70)

evaluation.regime: w21_envmap with the worklog-22 corrected references (results/8dna_replication/w21_reference_correction/<state>/gt_A|gt_B.exr), ROIs gt_design/v2
evaluation.render: upstream neuralpath, mode upstream (the rebuild's own frame is T3, no pullback), T3 scene of protocol/teaset_frozen_locked.json, res 512, 512 spp, chunk 4, seed 0 -- as render_8dna_refits.py
evaluation.rule: cross_backbone_eval.refit_block, imported unchanged: refit T3 interaction error <= 1.25 x T0 model error on the same surfaces at T0 AND gain <N(T3) - N_T0(T0), dG>/<dG,dG> >= 0.5

8dna_envmap_primary.reproduction_gate: the rebuild's last.ckpt (the historical selection) must satisfy the rule. If it does not, 8DNA timing is NOT interpreted as a recovery baseline and reproducibility is diagnosed first; the recipe is not changed.

8dna_common_light_secondary.role: SECONDARY same-scene cross-backbone control; no extra training (the same 8DNA rebuild, evaluated in the common-light regime)

evaluation.render: as render_8dna_refits.py: protocol/teaset_cross_backbone_locked.json, 1024 spp, chunk 4, seed 0, mode upstream

rna_common_light.role: SECOND track; static-quality caveat (G1 margin 4%, worklogs 22-24) stays attached to every RNA reading

dataset.derived_protocol: the locked protocol with only rna_dataset_dir redirected to results/neural_recompute_cost/<run>/rna/datasets (historical datasets are not overwritten); every generation setting unchanged: 200 train / 40 val views, 512^2, 512 spp, chunk 128, seeds 11/12, delta directional light per pixel (train) / per image (val)
dataset.reproducibility_check: the regenerated H5 files are compared channel by channel with the historical results/8dna_replication/rna_teaset/datasets/teaset_T3_{train,val}.h5

training.derived_config: identical except name (run_name below; it only names the logger directory and the validation EXRs RNA writes into its working directory) and the two dataset paths
training.host: RTX 5080, WSL Ubuntu-22.04, RNA .venv, launched through wsl_run_detached.sh (the worklog-23 5080 route; the cross-backbone protocol's rna_training.launch line names this route too)
training.snapshot_note: a weights-only checkpoint after epoch 0 and after every 5th epoch (epochs 4, 9, ..., 249), written to a WSL-native directory and copied out after the stage; the official top-10 val_psnr checkpoints and last.ckpt are also evaluated

evaluation.regime: teaset_cross_backbone_common_light, shared references as 8DNA common light
evaluation.render: rna_infer.py (unchanged), mode current, light model area-sampled, features results/8dna_replication/rna_teaset/features/T3.npz (historical inference input), train-h5 = this run's T3 train H5 (read only for its AABB attributes, unused in current mode)
evaluation.selection: validation-best val_psnr among the official checkpoints (render_rna_states.best_checkpoint rule)

deviations_from_worklog_22: RNA training runs on the RTX 5080 (WSL) instead of LabServer63, so all timing is on one host (batch section 2; user placement rule: 5080 first). Training is not bit-reproducible across hosts in any case (RNA's own code notes grid_sample on CUDA is non-deterministic); recovery is re-measured on this run's checkpoints, never borrowed from worklog 22.
Outputs (datasets, checkpoints, logs) go to results/neural_recompute_cost/<run>/; historical directories are read-only for this batch.

Timing instrumentation: event wrappers, one Lightning callback, per-epoch weight snapshots, torch.cuda.synchronize at phase boundaries. No change to model, loss, optimiser, data, schedule, seed or evaluation.

timing.clock: time.time() for wall-clock marks (comparable across processes on the host); perf_counter for durations inside one process; the WSL-vs-Windows clock offset is measured by the chain before and after the WSL stage
timing.memory: per process: torch max_memory_allocated/reserved; whole-GPU nvidia-smi memory.used peak over the pre-job baseline (2 s poll; WDDM/WSL give no per-process figure); host peak working set (Windows) / max RSS (WSL)
timing.serial_execution: every stage runs alone on the GPU, no other GPU job in parallel

quality_time_trace.8dna: every epoch's snapshot rendered at T3 in both regimes and scored with refit_block; plus the per-epoch built-in validation loss (val/loss, render_simple at val_spp 128) logged by upstream train.py
quality_time_trace.rna: snapshots (epoch 0 and every 5th) plus the official top-10 and last.ckpt rendered at T3 and scored with refit_block; plus per-epoch val_psnr / val_loss from the official validation

inference_timing.8dna: final model (last.ckpt export) at T3, upstream neuralpath, 512^2: the evaluation renders' own wall time at the historical spp (512 envmap, 1024 common light), plus 5 warm repeats of a 1-spp render per regime (time only; no quality claim at 1 spp)
inference_timing.rna: final (validation-best) model at T3, 512^2: (a) G-buffer + 16 area-light samples per sub-pixel (rna_bridge features, written to this run's directory) and (b) network evaluation of all 16 sub-pixel x 16 light-sample queries, 5 warm repeats after a warm-up, model load and feature-file read reported separately

budget_context.worklog_26_context_only: BMW27, 1080p, Cycles, persistent data, after a rigid change: 16 spp 0.22 s, 64 spp 0.76 s, 256 spp 3.0 s. Different scene and resolution, not quality matched: cost context only, never an equal-quality speed ratio.

identity_check.purpose: instrumentation non-perturbation check at smoke scale (nrc_identity_check.py): historical launcher x2 plain vs once instrumented, final weights compared; never evidence
identity_check.tolerance_note: set after the first smoke-scale check showed both trainers are not bit-deterministic run to run (8DNA plain-vs-plain max |dw| 0.021; RNA 3.7e-9), before any evidence run: an instrumented run passes if it differs from each plain run by at most 2x the plain-vs-plain difference

smoke.purpose: pipeline and accounting check only; never evidence
